title: erbyu's Happier Ghasts (Gillless)
description: Slightly changes Happy Ghasts to look happier. (Now without gills)
body:
erbyu's Happier Ghasts (gillless)

Think the Happy Ghast doesn't look happy enough? You want a bigger smile? It's not just you. Here's a resource pack that slightly modifies the Happy Ghast's texture to be just a little bit happier.

See also

The Gilled version — The same resource pack, but with gills.
